text:
Tess: Quick sync  pricing experiment checklist: finalize FAQ inline vs accordion, pick final tier names, lock calculator default and the webinar gating rule. Need decisions by EOD for the launch post mock.

Rory: My vote for names: Flex / Commit / Premier. Short, maps to behavior.

Mina: UX: default calculator to 'Estimated monthly spend (USD)' and include a small savings slider that shows projected savings if you switch to Commit. Also include an assumptions modal (tokens/request, avg calls/day).

Colt: Benchmarks: show one sample workload (support bot, 2.5k tokens/day). Use example prices: Flex $0.072/1k, Commit $0.048/1k, Premier $0.029/1k. Display p95 latency next to each.

Anya: FAQ drafts (short, inline answers): 1) "How am I billed?" -> billed per 1k tokens; link to docs. 2) "Can I bring my model?" -> yes, via Dedicated/Private. 3) "Do you offer SLAs?" -> list per-tier SLOs. 4) "Can I change mid-cycle?" -> upgrades prorated. 5) "How long are logs retained?" -> default retention + options. 6) "Are there discounts for volume?" -> contact accounts.

Tess: A/B test idea: Variant A shows FAQs inline under each tier; Variant B uses an accordion FAQ under the pricing grid. Hypothesis: inline answers reduce support clicks but may clutter. We'll track time-on-page and help-center clicks.

Rory: Webinar gating: when someone signs up for the pricing webinar, capture `calc_monthly_est` and `company_email`. Routing rule: if calc_monthly_est >= 1300 AND company_email domain not in personal_providers -> mark lead as "pricing_warm" and assign to AE pool; else nurture track. I'll own the SFDC flow.

Mina: Small copy tweak: change label to "Estimated monthly spend (USD)" and footer: "Estimate based on your inputs." Also change button text to "Get estimate & resources" on the calc.

Colt: For the savings slider, show a tiny row: "Estimated savings if committed: $X/mo (~Y%)". Use simple formula: est_cost = tokens_per_request * requests_per_day * price_per_1k / 1000.

LeadBot: Feature flags created: pricing_faq_layout_ab, pricing_calc_savings, pricing_tier_labels_v4.

Anya: Tone note for FAQ: short, actionable, no legalese. e.g., "Yes — bring your own model on Private." Keep < 20 words each.

Tess: Timeline: copy freeze by tomorrow 12pm, design mock by Wed, front-end flags Wed/Thu, QA Fri. Launch post + webinar invite go live next Mon.

Rory: I'll post the SFDC flow export and sample lead tags by EOD.

Mina: UX will hand off two mock variants (inline vs accordion) by 3pm for review.

Colt: I'll generate the benchmark images and attach them to the mock.

Tess: Thanks team  keep updates short in this thread. If you hit blockers ping me directly. :sparkles:
